I sat down with @TrevinPeterson  (⁠ https://x.com/trevinofficial ⁠) to break down how people are making money by filming simple Amazon product review videos with their phones. We talked about how the Amazon Influencer Program works, how to get approved, which products to review, and why longer, authentic videos often perform best. Trevin also shared how creators can get free products from brands, earn increased commissions, cross-post their videos to YouTube, and use tools like Viral Vue to find products with strong demand and low competition. Finally, he walked us through exactly how to film a simple review and explained how some people have scaled this into a serious part-time income.

Enjoy!
